extracted.intended_audience: C-suite executives, boards, investor relations teams, and communications leaders at public companies or companies preparing to list
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for designing and executing financial communications, investor relations (IR), ESG disclosure, and restructuring communications to protect and enhance enterprise value across capital-market events.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deliver a compelling equity story
rubrics_metrics.description: Help clients deliver a compelling equity story to the market, and attract and retain investment from high-quality shareholders.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Draw upon deep sector and capital markets expertise; design programs that communicate impact and advance business objectives. Tailor messaging to different investor audiences and use research-based approaches.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ground communications in research and best practices
rubrics_metrics.description: Grounded in research and best practices, our global team can execute programs in any financial market in the world.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use custom research and benchmarking to inform strategy, ensuring communications reflect market norms and investor expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide strategic counsel around IR best practices
rubrics_metrics.description: Providing strategic counsel around IR best practices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Advise management/IR teams on governance of communications, cadence of disclosure, targeting of investor audiences, and integration with broader corporate strategy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Drive broader interest and awareness in the equity story
rubrics_metrics.description: Driving broader interest and awareness in their equity story.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use targeted outreach, thought leadership, and media/investor engagement to increase visibility among relevant investors and analysts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Develop impactful engagement strategies to access capital markets
rubrics_metrics.description: Developing impactful engagement strategies to gain full access to the capital markets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design programs (roadshows, investor days, one-on-ones) that maximize meaningful investor access and address investor concerns.

rubrics_metrics.name: Navigate complex, multi-stakeholder issues, transactions and events
rubrics_metrics.description: Helping navigate complex, multi-stakeholder issues, transactions and events.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Coordinate messaging across stakeholders (investors, regulators, employees, customers) during transactions or crises to minimize reputational and financial risk.

rubrics_metrics.name: Plan and execute world-class (virtual) investor days
rubrics_metrics.description: Creating and executing world-class (virtual) investor days.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design agenda, messaging, investor materials, technical logistics, and follow-up to ensure investor days communicate strategic priorities effectively.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use customized perception research to measure IR effectiveness
rubrics_metrics.description: Conducting customized perception research to track, measure and benchmark IR programs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Deploy perception studies and benchmarking to evaluate program impact, identify gaps, and calibrate ongoing IR activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: ESG programs must be authentic and data-grounded
rubrics_metrics.description: Companies must develop an ESG program that is authentic, grounded in data, aligned with the company’s strategy and the needs of key stakeholders, and integrated across the organization.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid superficial claims; ensure metrics and disclosures are supported by verifiable data and tied to corporate strategy and stakeholder priorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evaluate ESG programs against industry best practices
rubrics_metrics.description: Evaluating current ESG programs, policies, and industry best practices to assess potential risks and opportunities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Perform gap analyses to identify weaknesses, regulatory exposure, and opportunities for improvement relative to peers and frameworks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adopt relevant sustainability reporting frameworks and standards
rubrics_metrics.description: Providing guidance on the adoption of relevant sustainability reporting frameworks and standards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recommend and map to appropriate frameworks (e.g., CSRD, others) that fit company context and investor/regulatory expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prioritize disclosures, define KPIs, and set targets
rubrics_metrics.description: Prioritizing key areas of disclosure, defining key performance indicators, establishing goals and targets, and developing a comprehensive and cohesive ESG narrative that aligns with a company’s mission and values.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focus on material topics, establish measurable KPIs and time-bound targets, and craft a narrative that links ESG performance to long-term value creation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Develop sustainability reporting and disclosure hubs
rubrics_metrics.description: Developing the sustainability report and relevant webpages to serve as central hub for all key ESG disclosures and updates on sustainability performance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Create accessible, up-to-date disclosure platforms (reports, web pages) that consolidate ESG data and narratives for stakeholders and regulators.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amplify ESG messages through targeted stakeholder engagement
rubrics_metrics.description: Amplifying messages through engagement with key stakeholders including investors, customers, and employees, as well as influential third parties, such as rating agencies and proxy advisors, policymakers and regulators, and community leaders.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proactively engage and align messaging with influential third parties to improve credibility and understanding of ESG commitments and performance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preserve business continuity during restructuring
rubrics_metrics.description: Preserving business continuity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Communications should prioritize continuity of operations and reassure stakeholders about critical functions and commitments during restructuring.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support restructuring with comprehensive internal and external communications
rubrics_metrics.description: Our experts understand restructuring processes ... and support you with internal and external communications, engagement and enablement strategies, plans and execution that reach all target audiences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Develop audience-specific materials (employees, creditors, customers, regulators), timing plans, and channels to ensure consistent and legally compliant messaging throughout restructuring.

rubrics_metrics.name: Position-based advocacy and accurate media coverage
rubrics_metrics.description: Position-based advocacy and focus: counsel companies, creditors and other stakeholders on all issues specific to restructuring; apply media relations and governmental affairs expertise to help clients advocate and articulate issue-specific views and ensure accurate and balanced media coverage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Craft advocacy strategies for different stakeholder groups and proactively manage media narratives to prevent misinformation and bias.

rubrics_metrics.name: Protect credibility and preserve stakeholder support
rubrics_metrics.description: Protecting credibility: communications advisory focused on preserving stakeholder support and safeguarding credibility.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Create truthful, consistent narratives; prepare spokespeople; and respond transparently to stakeholder concerns to maintain trust.

rubrics_metrics.name: Articulate a compelling vision and transparency on go-forward strategies
rubrics_metrics.description: Laying a foundation for the future: engage stakeholders by articulating a compelling vision for the future and conveying it through clear messaging that also provides transparency on restructuring plans.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Balance aspirational messaging with concrete steps and timelines so stakeholders understand the path forward and the rationale for decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Communications strategy development and announcement execution planning
rubrics_metrics.description: Communications strategy development, including overarching messaging creation and announcement execution planning.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Develop core messages, Q&A, timelines, channel strategies, and stakeholder outreach plans to ensure coherent, coordinated announcements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pre-announcement scenario planning and leak mitigation
rubrics_metrics.description: Pre-announcement scenario planning, including leak mitigation and response strategies and post-announcement contingency planning.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Anticipate potential leaks and adverse scenarios; prepare reactive scripts, escalation paths, and contingency plans to minimize disruption and reputational harm.

rubrics_metrics.name: Message and media training for leaders and key communicators
rubrics_metrics.description: Message and media training for leaders and key communicators.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prepare executives on core messages, interview techniques, handling hostile questions, and staying on message across channels.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deploy proactive and reactive media strategies
rubrics_metrics.description: Proactive and reactive media strategies and engagement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proactively place narrative-driving content while being prepared with rapid-response protocols for adverse media or issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Brief key regulators, government officials, and influencers
rubrics_metrics.description: Briefing of key regulators, government officials and influencers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Engage relevant authorities and influencers early with factual briefings to build understanding and preempt regulatory or political escalation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Investor relations outreach and inquiry management
rubrics_metrics.description: Investor relations outreach and inquiry management.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Manage investor inquiries consistently, log interactions, provide timely responses, and use feedback to refine messaging and disclosure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Train functional teams and manage supplier/customer call centers
rubrics_metrics.description: Training of procurement, sales and accounting teams, as well as supplier and customer call center management.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure front-line and customer-facing teams are briefed and equipped with approved messaging to handle stakeholder questions and issues consistently.

rubrics_metrics.name: Create tailored print, digital and in-person communications
rubrics_metrics.description: Creation of print, digital and in-person communications tailored for stakeholder audiences and channels.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adapt content format and tone to each stakeholder group and channel (press releases, web content, investor decks, town halls).

rubrics_metrics.name: Produce multilingual and multimedia assets and coordinate logistics
rubrics_metrics.description: Translation, video production, website and graphics development, and coordination of meetings and calls with company and advisers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide production support and localization to ensure consistent global messaging and smooth execution of investor/press events.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conduct post-event stakeholder research to evaluate outcomes
rubrics_metrics.description: Post-event stakeholder research highlighting current perceptions, threats and opportunities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use post-event surveys and perception studies to assess effectiveness, identify emerging risks, and inform follow-up communications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Implement ongoing positioning programs and thought leadership
rubrics_metrics.description: Ongoing positioning programs and thought leadership.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sustain visibility and narrative control through regular thought leadership, media engagement, and strategic positioning aligned to corporate strategy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Employee engagement and change management
rubrics_metrics.description: Employee engagement and change management.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Integrate internal communications and change-management practices to maintain morale, clarify roles, and enable operational transition during transformations.
